verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.sm: ONA fetalai mai lea o Ieova ia J Mose ma Arona i le nuu o Aikupito, o loo faapea mai,

verses.en: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.
verses.sm: E avea lenei masina ia te outou ma uluai masina, o le masina muamua lava lea ia te outou i le tausaga.

verses.en: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:
verses.sm: Ia oulua fai atu i le faapotopotoga uma o Isaraelu, ia faapea atu, O le aso e sefulu o lenei masina ia taitasi ai i latou ma lana tamai mamoe i aiga o latou tamā, o le aiga ma le tamai mamoe.

verses.en: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.
verses.sm: Pe afai foi e toaitiiti le aiga, e le mafai ona uma sa latou tamai mamoe, ona la faatasi ai lea ma le ua tuaoi o la aiga, e tusa ma le faitau aofai o tagata ; ia faatatau le tamai mamoe ma tagata latou te aai ai.

verses.en: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:
verses.sm: la sao ona lelei la outou tamai mamoe, o le poa, e tasi lona tausaga, tou te au mai ai i le lafu mamoe, po o le lafu ‘oti.

verses.en: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.
verses.sm: Tou te tausi i ai sua ooatui le aso e sefulu ma le fa o lenei masina; ona fasi ai lea e le faapotopotoga atoa uma o Isaraelu i le afiafi.

verses.en: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.
verses.sm: Ia latou ave foi nisi toto, ma avatu i pou e lua o le faitotoa ma ona faalava i luga i o latou fale latou te aai ai.

verses.en: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.
verses.sm: Latou te aai foi le tino i lea lava po, ua tunu i le afi, atoa foi ma areto e le faafefeteina, ma laau oona latou te inai a‘i,

verses.en: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.
verses.sm: Aua tou te aai ai e faalevela po o tunua i le vai, a ia tunua lava i le afi, o lona ulu, ma ona vae, nia ona tōtōga.

verses.en: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.
verses.sm: Aua foi nefi ai se mea e toe, e oo i le taeao; a o se mea e toe, e oo i le taeao, ia susunu lava ia i le afi.

verses.en: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD'S passover.
verses.sm: la faapea foi ona outou aai ai, o outou sulugatiti ia ma o outou tootoo i o outou lima, tou te aai ai faataalise ; o le paseka lava lea ia Ieova.

verses.en: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the LORD.
verses.sm: Auā o le po nanei, ou te ui ane ai i le nuu o Aikupito, ma ou taia ulumatua uma lava i le nuu o Aikupito, o tagata atoa ma manu ; ou te faasala f'oi i atua uma lava o Aikupito ; o a‘u lava o Ieova.

verses.en: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: E fai foi le toto ma faailoga ia te outou i fale tou te i ai, ou te vaai atu foi i le toto, ona ou sosopo ai lea ia te outou; e le oo foi ia te outou le mala e fano ai, pe a ou taia le nuu o Aikupito.

verses.en: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.
verses.sm: E fai foi lenei aso ma faamanatuga ia te outou, tou te fai ai foi le tausamiga ia Ieova; e faia i a outou tupulaga amuli le tausamiga, o le tulafono e faavavau.

verses.en: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
verses.sm: E fitu aso tou le aai ai areto e le faafefeteina ; o le aso muamua lava tou te ave ese ai mea e faafefete a‘i i o outou fale ; auā ai se ‘ai le areto ua faafefeteina e afua i le aso muamua e oo i le aso fitu, e vavaeeseina lea tagata i Isaraelu.

verses.en: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.
verses.sm: Tou te faia foi le faapotopotoga paia i le aso muamua, ma le faapotopotoga paia i le aso fitu ; aua le fai ai se galuega e tasi, tau lava o mea e tai a tagata uma, na o lea tou te faia.

verses.en: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.
verses.sm: la outou tausi foi i le tausamiga o areto e le faafefeteina, auā o lenei lava aso ua ou au mai ai a outou 4au nai le nuu o Aikupito, o le mea lea tou te tausi ai lenei aso i a outou tupulaga amuli, o le tulafono iea e faavavau.

verses.en: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.
verses.sm: O le uluai masina, o le aso e sefulu ma le fa o le masina, o le afiafi, tou te aai ai areto e le faafefeteina, seia oo i le afiafi o le aso e luafulu ma le tasi o le masina.

verses.en: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.
verses.sm: O ona aso ia e fitu aua ne‘i iloa ai i o outou fale se mea e faafefete a‘i; auā ai se ‘ai le areto e faafefeteina, 0 vavaeeseina lea tagata nai le faapotopotoga o lsaraelu, o le tagata ese atoa ma le tama a le eleele.

verses.en: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.
verses.sm: Aua ne‘i outou aai sina areto e faafefeteina; ia outou aai areto e le faafefeteina i mea uma tou te nonofo ai.

verses.en: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.
verses.sm: Ona aami lea e Mose le au toeaina uma o Isaraelu, ma na fai atu ia te i latou, Ia outou pupue ma ave mamoe mo outou aiga, ona outou fasi ai lea o le paseka.

verses.en: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.
verses.sm: Tou te ave foi se fusi isopo, ma fufui i le toto ua i le ipu, ma ta a‘i le laau faalava i luga ma pou e lua o le faitotoa i le toto i le ipu ; aua foi ne‘i ai so outou e ulufafo atu i le faitotoa o lona fale seia oo i le taeao.

verses.en: For the LORD will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you.
verses.sm: A afio ane foi ieova na te fasia Aikupito, pe a silafia e ia le toto i le laau faalava i luga ma pou e lua o le faitotoa, ona sosopo ane lea o ieova i lea faitotoa, na te le tuuina atu le na te fasiotia e ulu atu i o outou fale e fasi ia te outou.

verses.en: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.
verses.sm: Tou te tausia foi lenei mea, o le tulafono ia te oe atoa ma au fanau e faavavau lava.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.
verses.sm: A outou oo atu i le nuu e foaiina mai e Ieova ia te outou, faapei ona ia fetalaia mai, ona outou tausia lava lea lenei sauniga.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?
verses.sm: Pe a fai mai foi a outou fanau ia te outou, O le a ea le uiga ia te outou o lenei sauniga ?

verses.en: That ye shall say, It is the sacrifice of the LORD'S passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.
verses.sm: Ona outou tali atu ai lea, O le taulaga o le paseka lenei ia ieova, o le na sosopo ane i fale o le fanauga a Isaraelu i Aikupito, ina ua fasia e ia o Aikupito, a ua faasao mai e ia i o tatou aiga. Ona punonou lea o le nuu, ma ifo.

w.en: his and you all answered over

verses.en: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
verses.sm: Ona o atu lea o le fanauga a Isaraelu, ma latou faia e pei ona poloai ieova ia Mose ma Arona; sa faapea lava ona latou faia.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le tulua o po ma ao, ona fasi ai lea e Ieova o ulumatua uma lava i le nuu o Aikupito, o le ulumatua a Farao, o le na tietie i le nofoalii, atoa ma le ulumatua a le ua faatagataotauaina i le fale puipui, atoa uma ma ulumatua a manu.

verses.en: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea o Farao i le po, o ia ma ana auauna uma lava, atoa ma Aikupito uma, sa tele foi le tagiaue i Aikupito ; auā sa leai lava • se fale e aunoa ma le oti.

verses.en: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as ye have said.
verses.sm: Ona ia aami atu lea ia Mose ma Arona i le po, ua ia fai atu i ai, Ina tutū ia, o ese atu ia i lo‘u nuu, oulua atoa ma le fanauga a Isaraelu, o atu ia outou, ma auauna ia ieova, faapei ona oulua fai mai na.

verses.en: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.
verses.sm: la ave foi o outou lafu mamoe ma o outou lafu povi, pei ona oulua fai mai na, ma ia outou o ; ia oulua faamanuia mai foi ia te au lava.

verses.en: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men.
verses.sm: Ua nanati foi Aikupito i le nuu ina ia vave ona tuuina atu i latou e o ese i le nuu ; auā ua latou faapea ane, Ole a uma lava i tatou i le oti.

verses.en: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
verses.sm: Ona ave ai lea e le nuu o a latou -palugafalaoa, a o lei faafefeteina, atoa ma a latou mea e palu ai falaoa ua afifi i o latou ofu i luga i o latou ua.

verses.en: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
verses.sm: Ua fai foi e le fanauga a Isaraelu faapei ona fai mai ai Mose, ua latou fai atu ia Aikupito i mea ario, ma mea auro, atoa ma ofu.

verses.en: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.
verses.sm: Ua faatupuina e Ieova le alofa o Aikupito i le nuu; ua latou aumaia mea na fai atu ai; ua latou faamatitivaina ai Aikupito.

verses.en: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.
verses.sm: Ona 5 malaga lea o le fanauga a Isaraelu nai Ramese i Sukota, pe atoa le ono galau o afe o tagata malolosi o savavali, e lei faitaulia tama,

verses.en: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.
verses.sm: Ua o ae foi faatasi ma i latou tagata ese e toatele, atoa ma lafu mamoe ma povi, o mea e tele lava.

verses.en: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.
verses.sm: Ua latou tunu foi le palugafalaoa na latou aumaia nai Aikupito, o potoi areto e le faafefeteina; auā e lei faafefeteina, auā na tulia i latou nai Aikupito, e le mafai ona faatuatuai, e lei saunia foi sa latou oso.

verses.en: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.
verses.sm: O ona po foi sa nonofo ai le fanauga a Isaraelu i Aikupito, ua fa galau ma le tolugafulu o tausaga.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: Ua oo ina ua atoa o tausaga e fa galau ma le tolugafulu, o lea lava aso, na o ese atu ai o ‘au uma lava a ieova nai le nuu o Aikupito.

verses.en: It is a night to be much observed unto the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the LORD to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.
verses.sm: O le po lava lea e tausiusia mo Ieova, ina ua na au mai ai i latou nai le nuu o Aikupito; o le po lava lenei e tausiusia mo Ieova e le fanauga uma lava a Isaraelu i o latou tupulaga amuli.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi Ieova ia Mose ma Arona, O le tulafono lenei i le paseka; aua le a‘i ai se tagata ese.

verses.en: But every man's servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.
verses.sm: A o auauna uma lava a tagata ua faatauina i tupe pe a peritomeina so latou,.ona ‘ai ai lava lea o ia.

verses.en: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
verses.sm: O le aumau ma le galue i le totogi, aua ne‘i aai ai.

verses.en: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.
verses.sm: E tasi le fale e aai ai, aua ne‘i ave i fafo sina tufaaga nai le fale; aua foi ne‘i outou gagau sona ivi.

verses.en: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
verses.sm: E fai lava lenei mea e le faapotopotoga atoa uma o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
verses.sm: Pe afai foi e Aumau ia te oe se tagata ese, a manao ia e fai le paseka ia Ieova, ia peritomeina o tane uma lava ua ia te ia, ona faalatalata ane lea o ia e fai ai; e tusa aua ne‘i ‘ai ai se tasi e le peritomeina.

verses.en: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.
verses.sm: E tasi le tulafono mo le tama a le eleele, ma le tagata ese na te aumau ia te outou.

verses.en: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
verses.sm: Ona fai leae le fanauga uma lava a Isaraelu faapei ona poloai mai ai ieova ia Mose ma Arona, ua faapea ona latou faia.

verses.en: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
verses.sm: O lea lava aso na au mai ai e Ieova o le fanauga a Isaraelu nai le nuu o Aikupito i a latou lava ‘au.
